title: Comprida
description: The house has a T5 layout with an office, all arranged on a single floor. With a suite and walk-in closet included, the challenge was to resolve the layout on a site overlooking the Serra da Estrela, while “democratizing” the program in relation to this scenic aspect — namely the view. Thus, all the rooms in the house share this view, while circulation runs along the rear side of the building. The resulting form of the house consists of two fused volumes, slightly offset along their length. The long and potentially monotonous reading of the building is interrupted by moments of color and volume, scattered throughout the built mass.
